propositions: pandoc 3.6.1 corrupts arrows inside code spans, deletes HTML comments, and erodes tables when rendering commonmark to jira, requiring a two-phase segmenting renderer that locks protected blocks and preserves code fragments verbatim

the renderer must classify units into safe passthrough (locked blocks, headers, code tags), tables (wrapped once in {noformat}), HTML tags, regex-dangerous prose, and pandoc-convertible prose, with code-fragment post-render verification to catch escaping failures

a deterministic 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with measured body ratio >=0.90 and character ratio >=0.95 must demonstrate that rendering changes occur and are correctness-preserving

pypandoc-binary 1.15 pinning and non-skipping real-binary verification (pandoc 3.6.1, exact jira writer output shapes, no color form emission) must gate linux/macOS CI; missing pandoc falls back to identity with content-free wiki_render_fallback logging

inline-jira classification must distinguish unambiguous wiki markers ({{code}}, [label|target], {color:name}) from ambiguous markdown (*bold*, _italic_) to prevent 2-cycle instability when re-rendering already-wiki text
five-pass stability (from markdown source through five render cycles) must produce idempotent output with zero body drift, proven by deterministic fixed-point analysis and cached corpus measurements
